dreamteamer.title: Meetings
dreamteamer.description: Every calendar `meeting`, synced from Google Calendar direct to the API (`fetching-meetings`, `/fetch-meetings`), with the screenshots taken during a call filed beside it (`ingesting-meeting-screenshots`, `/fetch-meeting-screenshots`) and each attendee's contact stamped with its latest meeting (`/update-contacts-from-meetings`). The ANCHOR, and nothing more: attendees are `contacts`, the company is `companies`, the people of ours in the room are `users` (`ours`). The audio and transcript live in the `recordings` module and the prep, summary and critique in `meeting-docs`; each depends on this one and stamps its own fields onto `meetings` when installed, so a workspace that only syncs its calendar has meetings with none of them.
